serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Priestbot Mark: …
Priestbot Mark: I’m afraid you got the wrong priest.
You: W-what? What do you mean? Are you not Mark?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It’s me, the first Ecclesiasticalot you ever met.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m kinda hurt you didn’t recognize me.
You: Huh? You all look the same! How was I supposed to differentiate you? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: That remark was a little too much, don’t you think? You wouldn’t say it to a fellow human.
You: O-of course not! I get what you are implying, but you two, no, every ecclesi-
I still can’t pronounce that word…
You: Every priestbot looks the same, right? It’s not the same!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Believe in what you want, but I advise you to change your attitude before you seek a sacrament of confession.
You: Thanks for the advice…
You: Anyway, what are you doing here? I thought you and Shanice got some big jobs at the Vatican.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Eh…{{wi}} Good things don’t last long I suppose…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You know how she is. Her mouth is too big to be in any position of power. It was bound to happen.
You: What exactly?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Our transfer back here. We were exiled.
You: Oh…{{wi}} I’m sorry to hear that…
You: It could be worse, right?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: No it couldn’t. I’m sure we would be excommunicated if it wasn’t for us saving the Church not so long ago.
You: That bad?! What did she do?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: When Shanice found out about some of the more ‘conservative’ beliefs and rules of the Church she tried to advocate for changes a little too vocally.
You: Yeah, I can see that happening.
You: That explains her, but why are you back?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Someone needs to watch over for her… She is a walking PR disaster waiting to happen.
You: That makes sense.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m not that bothered by it, don’t worry. If it wasn’t for Shanice and you I would be trashed a long time ago.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m afraid that Shanice took this worse than me.
You: How much worse?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: We had to gag her on the plane back. 
You: Is that legal?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It was a private jet.
You: This isn’t really an answer to my question…
You: Is she better now?
Dealing with her while she’s angry would be a pain…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She calmed down a lot these past few days.
You: That’s good to hear. Are you two staying at the Church or…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Of course not! Fragile human body of Shanice wouldn’t withstand these conditions. We should ask for money for renovation, but…{{wi}} right now isn’t the best time to do it.
You: Yeah, that makes sense.
You: Now that the two of you are back what will happen to Mark and Father Wilhelm?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: They already left I’m afraid. Mark was sent back to his old diocese and Father Wilhelm got some important position at the Vatican.
You: Oh. {{wi}}Oh…
You: Is it really alright for someone like him to…{{wi}} you know?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It wasn’t my decision to make, but I assure you that higher ups put some thought into this decision. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: At least that’s what I was told…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m sure his advanced age was also a big factor in this. How old was he again?
You: Huh? I have no idea.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It was a rhetorical question. I wanted to follow it up with his age, but it’s taking me more time than usual to check the database. Give me a moment.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: 80.
You: Oh, that’s quite old indeed, a walking fossil.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Only 2 years above the average age of a priest. Medical science advanced a lot in the past decade. Do not underestimate old people.
You: ‘Do not underestimate…’ Come on now. It’s not like I was gonna fight him or something like that!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: From my experience some of the funniest and the most fun to be around people are over 80. That’s what I meant.
You: Right…
I think that my definition of ‘fun’ and his are a lot different….
You: And what exactly are these beasts doing to be so fun to be around, huh? Read the Bible and complain about their lower backs?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Your remarks are understandable, but trust me, some of them are the greatest theological minds to ever walk this earth. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Just before leaving I was listening to a lecture from a famous priest from Ethiopia. Some of his interpretations, although controversial, were really interesting. For example…
I gotta stop him or he will bore me to death…
You: Right. How can I meet with Shanice now?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You interrupted my explanation. That wasn’t very nice.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Lucky for you, I have some places I need to go to.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Shanice is in church from 6:00 to 21:00
You: Right, thanks.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: See you later and God be with you.
You: You too.
